svg.text: Task names, methods, coverage, and metric normalization in one comparison view.
Filled areas show complete scored baselines; colored points show partial branches on task-aligned axes.
Each axis is one task. Longer radius means better after metric-direction normalization.
Each method has 20 records; scored axes and scoreless statuses stay in the JSON matrix.
Single-episode simple heads over the public sample split.
Single-episode compact PyTorch MLP heads on the same 20 task contracts.
128-episode 4430-dim sensor NPZ simple heads; tasks 15/19 use compact proxies.
128-episode 4430-dim sensor NPZ MLP heads; tasks 15/19 use compact proxies.
Verified held-out Qwen3-Omni v6 LoRA metrics, plus task 16 and any completed
private-GPU future-task probes scored from task-specific JSON.
Verified Cosmos3-Super base-weight Reasoner JSON-task evaluation, plus task 16
scored from existing verified action/object JSON.
Full task names are listed here so the polygon remains readable at homepage scale.
Every method has 20 task records; radius appears only where a numeric task score exists.
Raw128 completion: 18 direct task targets plus 2 compact proxies. Task 15 predicts the dominant caption/object/interaction hash bin; task 19 retrieves depth/audio sync from camera pose.
Scoreless metadata/Qwen/Cosmos records are explicit unsupported or not-evaluated cells in docs/data/task_method_20_result_matrix.json.
